note: Standing memory of tracked threads. The morning run appends to log (newest last), sets status, and never deletes entries. Citations [n] in t refer to the edition that added the entry; the same sources are copied into src so links keep working.

log.t: France 11–12 Oct, then seven countries 1–2 Nov including a SE distribution centre. Belgian criminal case open. [2, 45]
src: Suspected cyberattacks trigger supermarket fridge failures across Europe

log.t: Germany (Reisbach, Wuppertal, Raesfeld) and Portugal (seven Intermarché stores) added: at least 11 countries since 1 Nov. Commissioner Hansen calls it a deliberate attempt to disrupt the food supply; US officials privately suspect Iran-linked hackers for the commissary hits; Rome's crisis meeting found limited impact in Italy. [34, 35, 36, 44, 45, 47]
src: Mutmaßlicher Cyberangriff auf Rewe-Markt in NRW
New Wave of Refrigeration Cyberattacks Hits Supermarkets Across Europe
Officials suspect Iran of cyberattacks on military base freezers

Attacchi hacker ai supermercati in Europa, anomalie anche in Italia. Cosa sappiamo

log.t: Kaiserslautern and Kusel cases confirmed by police; more than 100 stores hit, 13 in Ireland; two former US officials told NPR some evidence points to Iran for the commissary outages. [42, 43, 45]
src: Hackerangriffe in Europa: Supermärkte müssen Lebensmittel entsorgen
Over 100 European stores hit as supermarket fridge attacks return
A new cold war: hackers target fridges across the globe

log.t: France's blood service says three plasma cold stores were hit through supplier Coolworld on 2 Nov; Lupovis puts Russian involvement at “about 95 percent” while Romania's cyber chief rules out a state actor; the UK reports small meat processors targeted. [41, 46, 43]
src: Blood banks hit by cyberattack in France days after European freezer hacks
Cyberattack on supermarket refrigeration systems "may be the work of hackers with links to Russia"
EU urges action as Germany, Romania and UK report supermarket cyberattacks

log.t: Five US agencies issued joint guidance on refrigeration and cold-chain systems as DoD looks at freezer failures in about six commissaries; the Kremlin called the accusations “absurd”. [36, 38]
src: US agencies warn of refrigeration hacks amid suspected attacks on military bases
Kremlin denies Russia role in fridge cyber attacks

log.t: No new arrests in the window; extraditions from Germany pending. Lithuania filed terrorism charges and Turkey detained 85 on 27 Oct. [16, 17, 18]

Turkey detains 85 in raids on gang suspected in Poland Starlink sabotage

log.t: German police arrested a Turkish national in the Reutlingen district, accused of sending two men to set fire to a Starlink ground station in Poland on 23 Sep. [49]
src: Suspected mastermind behind Starlink attack arrested

log.t: Option sets due to Hegseth 6 Nov; review completes in December. [22, 23]
src: Pentagon Europe posture review terms of reference
Pentagon's NATO review preparing troop options by November 6

log.t: Option sets go to Hegseth on 6 Nov; NBC reported they include withdrawing at least 25,000 of about 80,000 US personnel. Five NATO diplomats fear deeper cuts if Republicans lose. Poland's security council met on a base Warsaw would pay $3–4 billion for; Sikorski says Washington will decide by December. [51, 52, 53, 55, 56]
src: NATO allies fear Trump could target alliance after potential US midterm defeat: report

Stała baza USA w Polsce głównym tematem obrad RBN

log.t: Option sets due to Hegseth on 6 Nov, nothing published; Lithuania's defence minister told the US ambassador to NATO that Lithuania is ready to host more US forces. [59]

src: Kherson braces as localised truce ends

src: Kabinet schrapt vrijheidsbijdrage voor 2027 en stelt nieuw box 3-stelsel jaar uit

src: CU en 50Plus positief, andere bondjes willen doorpraten over belastingplan

L'Arizona au pied du mur : la démission de Bart De Wever en suspens, le Roi entame ses entrevues ce mardi
